Title: All six products show the same dog photo for problem_user
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open saucedemo.com.
2. Log in as problem_user with the password shown on the login page.
3. Look at the product images on the Products page.
4. Log in as standard_user in another tab and compare.
Expected Behavior: Each product shows its own image, as it does for standard_user.
Actual Behavior: All six products show the same photo of a dog.
Notes: Practice site with seeded issues. Product detail pages were not checked for problem_user.

Title: Checkout accepts a one-letter postal code ('o') and completes the order
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as standard_user.
2. Add Backpack, Bike Light and Bolt T-Shirt to the cart.
3. Open the cart and click Checkout.
4. Enter First Name 'a', Last Name 'a', Zip/Postal Code 'o'.
5. Click Continue, then Finish.
Expected Behavior: The postal code is checked for a valid format and length, and the user cannot continue with 'o'.
Actual Behavior: No error is shown. The Overview page opens and the order completes with 'Thank you for your order!'.
Notes: The field is labelled Zip/Postal Code and postal codes can contain letters in some countries, so the expected result is a format and length check, not digits only. A single letter is not valid anywhere. One-letter first and last names are also accepted, which looks doubtful but may be intended.

Title: Error state stays on filled fields and after the user corrects them
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as standard_user, add an item and open Checkout.
2. Type 'b' in First Name only and click Continue.
3. Look at the three fields and the red banner.
4. Type 'b' in Last Name and Zip/Postal Code without clicking Continue.
Expected Behavior: Only the field with the problem is marked red. The error clears once the user fixes it.
Actual Behavior: The First Name field, which is filled, also gets a red outline and icon. The banner says only 'Last Name is required'. After step 4 the red outlines and the banner stay until Continue is clicked again.
Notes: Only one missing field is reported at a time, which is a separate small point.
